name: esp32_8048s070c
title: Sunton ESP32-8048S070C
description: 7-inch 800x480 EK9716 on parallel RGB, GT911 touch, an I2S amplifier; an ESP32-S3 with 16 MB flash and 8 MB octal PSRAM
notes: The frame buffers of the display lie in PSRAM, and the interrupt that copies them to the panel runs on the core that made the display: call board_display_init from the task that draws. At 33 MHz the other core keeps off PSRAM; docs/rgb-display-en.md of DGX gives the clocks that hold.

GPIO18 is LRCLK of the amplifier through R27 and TP_INT of the touch through R17, both 0 ohm on the schematic. On the photo of a board R17 is empty and R27 fitted: INT of the touch reaches no GPIO, as the Arduino demo of the vendor has it (TOUCH_GT911_INT -1).
GPIO0 is the BOOT button and BCLK of the amplifier through R28: while the sound plays the button reads the clock, and a press holds BCLK low. The board V1.0 had BCLK on GPIO19, the SDA of the touch.

The schematic also has a resistive touch, an XPT2046 on the lines of the TF slot: CS 38, CLK 12, DIN 11, DOUT 13, IRQ 18. On the photo of a board U1 is empty and its connector K1 fitted. The specification names only the board with no touch (ESP32-8048S070N) and the capacitive one; this data is the capacitive board.
The reset of the panel goes to an RC circuit (R16, C35), not to a GPIO.
GPIO19 and GPIO20, the USB of the chip, are the I2C of the touch: USB1 reaches the chip through the CH340C only.

mcu.notes: An ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 by the specification and the schematic, with 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM; GPIO35 to GPIO37, the lines of octal PSRAM, are not wired.

front.source: a photo of the board, 2026-11-20, straightened, reflections on the glass removed, the height brought to the 181 x 108 mm of the specification

back.source: a photo of the board, 2026-11-20, straightened, the height brought to the 181 x 108 mm of the specification

pins.source: ESP32-8048S070-MCU-V1.1.png and ESP32-8048S070-LCM-V1.1.png, 5-Schematic of the vendor archive 7.0inch_ESP32-8048S070.zip

chip.source: ESP32-8048S070 Specifications-EN.pdf of the vendor archive: driver chip EK9716, ESP32-S3-WROOM-1, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM, effective display area 153.84 x 85.63 mm

glass.source: JC8048B070N.pdf, the sheet of the glass: 800 x 480, active area 154.08 x 85.92 mm, a pixel clock of 29 to 38 MHz; MODE high selects DE mode

pixel_clock.by: a contributor of DGX with the board; Anton saw the videos of the tests
pixel_clock.notes: The pins of this data and 33 MHz with two frame buffers: 59.5 frames a second while the processor draws as fast as it can, the display made on the core that draws. The demo of the vendor runs 16 MHz, the music demo 12.

backlight_pwm.by: a contributor of DGX with the board
backlight_pwm.notes: PWM on GPIO2 dims the backlight at 200 Hz and 1 kHz; at 5 kHz and above every duty below 100% leaves it dark.

schematic_parts.notes: From the schematic: no board through this component has run them.

touch_vendor.source: touch.h of the demo 7_1_lvgl_music_gt911_7.0 of the vendor archive: a GT911 on SDA 19, SCL 20, RST 38, INT -1; HAL.h of the same demo: I2S DOUT 17, BCLK 0, LRC 18

photo.by: a photo of the back of a board
photo.notes: R26 to R29 by U4 fitted, R17 empty, U1 empty. U4 has 8 pins, where the MAX98357 of the schematic has 16: its marking is not readable. The antenna of the module, a trace, lies at the edge of the board.

power.name: VBUS
power.why: USB1, type C. VDD of the amplifier U4 is on VBUS itself.

power.name: LEDA
power.why: EN of U5 is BL_CTR, the backlight line on GPIO2 through R13, held low by R14.

power.name: 3.3V
power.why: VGH, VGL and AVDD of the glass come from it through the DC-DC of the LCM sheet.

lcd.notes: The glass JC8048B070N on LCD1, 50 pins. B0 to B2, G0, G1 and R0 to R2 are on ground: 16 lines of RGB565. MODE is high, DE mode; L/R is high, U/D low. DCLK comes through L3, a ferrite bead. The timing is that of dgx_rgb_panel_jc8048b070n of DGX, from the demo of the vendor.

calibrations.notes: A placeholder: the touch taken as the glass, pixel for pixel. Measure the board with dgx_di_calibrate_measure and give the log to tools/board_calibration.py.

touch.notes: On FPC1, 6 pins: SDA GPIO19 and SCL GPIO20 with 4K7 to 3.3 V (R4, R3), REST GPIO38, INT on TP_INT. With INT not held at reset the address is not chosen: both are tried.

sound.notes: DIN GPIO17, LRCLK GPIO18, BCLK GPIO0, each through a 0 ohm resistor. The schematic names a MAX98357 with GAIN on ground and SD_MODE from VBUS through R29, whose value it does not give; on the photo of a board U4 has 8 pins, not the 16 of that chip. The speaker goes on P6.

usb_uart.notes: DTR and RTS reset the chip into its loader through T1 and T2.

reg_3v3.notes: The schematic gives no part number: a buck converter by its pins and L6.

led_driver.notes: The schematic gives no part number: a boost converter for the LEDs by its pins, L1 and D2.
